hero.title: South Ruchis Square: Bangalore's Legacy of Organic Vegetarian Excellence
hero.subtitle: Experience 60 years of culinary mastery, offering 100% organic, chemical-free vegetarian cuisine sourced directly from our own SOUTH RUCHIS farm.

about.title: Our Organic Legacy: 60 Years of Farm-to-Table Purity
about.paragraph1: For over six decades, South Ruchis Square, under the visionary guidance of Chairperson Mr. Pradeep G. R., has redefined authentic South Indian fine dining. As a proud second-generation family enterprise, our journey is steeped in a profound commitment to culinary excellence and an unwavering dedication to healthful, natural cuisine. We meticulously craft 100% organic vegetarian dishes, honouring a tradition of purity and taste that has delighted generations.
about.paragraph2: Our unique promise of unadulterated goodness stems from our proprietary 'SOUTH RUCHIS farm,' the very soul of our organic philosophy. Here, every ingredient flourishes in a chemical-free, pest-free environment, ensuring that each bite you take is packed with unparalleled natural flavour and nutritional integrity. Beyond our exquisite dine-in experience, we extend this commitment to natural purity through our range of organic products, including signature spices, masalas, oils, ghee, and convenient breakfast combos.
